decks.notes: This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with disruptive effects that can be repeatedly activated through blinking. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Aether Vial to flicker and return key creatures to the battlefield, the deck can both pressure the opponent and disrupt their game plan. Additionally, cards like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition provide removal options while maintaining board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive plays and disruptive tactics, creating a challenging and impactful gameplay experience.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to quickly dig through the deck, generate mana, and eventually win the game by either milling the opponent with Grinding Station or using Thassa's Oracle to draw the remaining cards in the library for victory. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide additional card advantage and digging capabilities, while the various artifacts and spells serve to support the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The overall strategy is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and execute the win condition as quickly as possible.

The deck aims to assemble combos using a toolbox of creatures, with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician as a key piece for generating value and controlling the board. Delighted Halfling and other small creatures provide fodder for Yawgmoth's abilities, while support cards like Blood Artist and Scavenging Ooze offer additional synergies. Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling help tutor for the right creature at the right time, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Malevolent Rumble provide answers to threats. Grist, the Hunger Tide serves as a game-ending threat, backed up by efficient mana sources like Boseiju, Who Endures and fetch lands.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides support for the creatures, while cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm help control the board. Additionally, the deck includes some utility cards like Goblin Bombardment and Seasoned Pyromancer for extra damage. The mana base allows for consistent casting of spells and abilities, with some land disruption provided by cards like Blood Moon and Arena of Glory.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, along with mana acceleration from Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to quickly ramp into large creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With additional support from control spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return, as well as Karn, the Great Creator for utility, the deck seeks to establish dominance and close out the game efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Ulamog, the Defiler and Emperor of Bones. By pairing these creatures with cards like Psychic Frog and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm opponents with powerful combos. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Force of Negation provide protection and disruption to help ensure the successful execution of the deck's game plan. Additionally, the mana base supports the deck's versatility and consistency in executing its reanimation strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana with spells like Desperate Ritual and Pyretic Ritual, while using cards like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible to draw through the deck. The deck aims to cast Past in Flames to recast all the spells from the graveyard and win the game with a massive combo turn. Wish serves as a versatile toolbox for finding key pieces, and Artist's Talent can be used to copy powerful spells. The deck is fast-paced and aims to overwhelm the opponent with a burst of powerful spells.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck focuses on early aggressive plays with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Ranger-Captain of Eos to control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. This deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively before the opponent has a chance to mount a defense.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be tutored for using cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith. The key strategy is to create a toolbox of creatures with powerful abilities that can be used to control the board, generate value, and ultimately combo off with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. The deck also includes cards like Blood Artist and Malevolent Rumble to pressure the opponent's life total and disrupt their game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's diverse casting costs and provide consistency in hitting important land drops.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful Eldrazi creatures, while also controlling the opponent's board through various spells and abilities. It utilizes cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana production, allowing for the casting of high-cost Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble help maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Karn, the Great Creator is used to search for key artifacts, providing additional utility and flexibility to the deck.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats while also having tools to deal with various situations through its versatile card choices.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize ramp cards such as Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator provides flexibility in dealing with a variety of threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi threats while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient creatures, removal spells, and disruptive hand disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while controlling the board state with removal and disruptive spells. The deck also includes powerful cards that generate card advantage and synergy with other cards in the deck. The mana base is carefully built to support the deck's overall strategy and maximize the chances of casting its spells on curve.

The main focus of this deck is to combine aggressive creature tactics with the ability to exile and return those creatures to the battlefield for additional value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Solitude, along with Aether Vial for mana acceleration, the deck aims to maintain a strong presence on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The Blink aspect of the deck enables powerful synergies and allows for strategic maneuvering to outpace the opponent and secure victories through efficient creature recursion and combat tricks.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively while utilizing blink effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects of creatures like Solitude and Witch Enchanter. The deck also includes strong aggro creatures such as Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones to pressure the opponent. Utilizing Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and disruption from cards like Fatal Push, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining card advantage through blinking synergies.
